name: SINCOR Healthcare Credentialing Agent
description: Automates provider credentialing, CAQH enrollment, payer enrollment, license tracking, and compliance packs for healthcare operators. High willingness-to-pay B2B vertical. Settles in SINC or AXM on Base.

skills.name: CAQH Enrollment
skills.description: Initiates and tracks CAQH profile completion and attestations.
examples: Create a CAQH onboarding packet for a new NP in Texas.

skills.name: Payer Enrollment
skills.description: Coordinates payer rostering and enrollment packet submission.
examples: Submit enrollment packet to a commercial payer for a new provider.

skills.name: License Surveillance
skills.description: Monitors expiring state licenses, DEA, and board certifications; alerts ops teams.
examples: List all licenses expiring in the next 60 days for the Texas roster.

skills.name: Credential Status Check
skills.description: NPI, license, DEA, and payer credentialing status lookup.
